<thought>Using the most intense peak at m/z 127.0997 as the [M+H]⁺ ion, subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The formula C₇H₁₂NO has an exact monoisotopic mass of 126.0919 Da, matching the observed mass within experimental error, and fits the allowed elements (C, H, O, and one heteroatom). Therefore the molecular formula is C₇H₁₂NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12NO</final_answer>
